gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 3 Randomized Double-blind, Controlled Study of ICT-107 With Maintenance Temozolomide (TMZ) in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Following Resection and Concomitant TMZ Chemoradiotherapy

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] ICT-107: Autologous dendritic cells pulsed with peptides associated with tumor antigens

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This is a Phase 3 study to evaluate ICT-107 in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: ICT-107 consists of dendritic cells, prepared from autologous mononuclear cells that are pulsed with six synthetic peptides that were derived from tumor associated antigens (TAA) present on glioblastoma tumor cells.
Arm 1 will receive ICT-107 in combination with the standard of care, temozolomide (TMZ), Arm 2 will receive TMZ with a blinded control.

agents.drug_class_hint: placebo control consisting of autologous monocyte-enriched PBMC

source_quote.quote: Subjects with glioblastoma mutated IDH by Immunohistochemistry (IHC)
All subjects must have glioblastoma tissue that has tumor assessment for MGMT methylation status prior to randomization (for stratification).

coder_notes: Investigational agent is an autologous dendritic-cell vaccine (excluded type); temozolomide is standard of care in both arms; placebo is autologous PBMC (listed as control_comparator). IDH-mutant glioblastoma is an exclusion, i.e. IDH-wildtype required (cns5; also 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' in conditions). HLA-A2 positivity required but is a germline marker, not recorded. MGMT used for stratification and subgroup outcomes. Filgrastim mentioned only as permitted, not listed.
